review_kind: independent provisional AI-simulated mathematical source and design review
scope: Transcription and epistemic accuracy of the newly written proposal against an independent manual review of the existing channel definitions, collision generator, staged law and specified finite-map construction.
assumptions: The proposed collision reads only a local unordered same-polarity pair and input layer; no A9 values, pending controls, diagnostics or additional records enter its selection.
The original collision family is the finite map defined by the cited existing generator. This review did not rerun its exhaustive certificate or regenerate the frozen tables.
Layer conjugation uses r=(-q) mod 3; all noncollision stages, admissible records and exactly-two eligibility remain unchanged.
Formation and persistence statements use the specified finite periodic homogeneous occupied background and the stated complete initial states.
Support minimality is measured in changed internal pair-table rows within the proposal's explicit comparison class.
The Bernoulli measure is an external finite counting reference at the specified initial collision, not an ontic probability law.
methods: Read the complete proposal with numbered lines.
Independently derived O_h and uniform C4 covariance from the polar, axial and pseudoscalar transformation laws.
Checked the layer-conjugation sign using U's layer decrement and U^3's phase action.
Derived D0 and P0 cardinalities and exact two-to-one, zero-preimage and singleton fibers.
Derived the stabilizer argument restricting incoming same-flag formation to the adjacent-phase orbit.
Manually decoded the relevant C0 packed entries and U channel entries from the existing native frozen transcription.
Manually traced both specified formation witnesses through the staged schedule.
Checked the finite alphabet factor count symbolically.
Derived the exact one-site, one-polarity initial Bernoulli total-variation drift.
Checked the inherited displaced same-flag pair non-restoring argument.

required_future_gates: Fresh successor law, collision-table and checkpoint identities; preserve original identities and reject incompatible checkpoints.
Exhaustive local pair-map checks, intermediate-record causal support, exact token and polarity accounting, and checkpoint continuation.
Execute the preregistered finite witnesses and controls without changing their acceptance criteria after outcomes.
Complete-state and event parity for every claimed backend.
New reference-evolution and error analysis before any successor continuum claim.
An independently specified additional mechanism before any restoring-binding or higher material-recovery claim.
limitations: No exhaustive table checks, source-law execution, backend parity tests or numerical campaigns were performed.
Moment conservation is evaluated at the input collision layer, not at every committed physical microtick.
O_h and C4 covariance are collision statements; no new full-runtime phase symmetry is certified.
Phase reversal fails and the predecessor selection is an explicit law price.
The new map invalidates the old full-support product-reference stationarity, isometry and multistep response evidence.
Formation is enabled by a selected local map; the displaced same-flag pair still has no restoring response.
The minimum changed-row count is neither a globally minimal ontology nor a uniqueness result.
closing_disclosure: This is a provisional, AI-simulated review, not a substitute for actual external human mathematical review. A human referee may identify errors missed here or reject concerns raised here.
